children: Global index provider FTSE's semi-annual index review comes into effect on Friday, September 18, with around 12 stocks getting added to its all cap index. The rebalancing for the same will take place during the final 30 minutes of today's trading session.
The FTSE semi-annual index review changes were announced on August 21, 2026 and September 18 was set as the adjustment date for the same.

As per analyst estimates, ACME Solar Holdings will be added to the index and receive potential inflows of $25 million, while Apollo Micro Systems and Avalon Technologies could receive flows of $20 million each. Cupid is likely to see flows worth $49 million, while Pine Labs, Urban Company could see flows worth $30 million and $37 million respectively.

Meanwhile, five stocks - Meesho, Groww, Lenskart, Infosys and Bharti Airtel, will witness an increase in their weightage on the FTSE indices.

The resultant change in weightage will bring inflows worth $65 million for Meesho, while Groww, Lenskart, Infosys and Bharti Airtel could see flows worth $50 million, $60 million, $45 million and $50 million, respectively.

title: FTSE Index Rebalancing Today: Here are the stocks you should keep an eye on
